files = [f for f in os.listdir('data/raman') if f.endswith('.csv')]
data = []
for f in files:
    path = os.path.join('data/raman', f)
    df_temp = pd.read_csv(path)
    # Identify columns dynamically based on preview: A=Raman Shift, B=Intensity
    x_col = df_temp.columns[0]
    y_col = df_temp.columns[1]
    
    shift = df_temp[x_col].values
    intensity = df_temp[y_col].values
    
    # I_G: max intensity in 1550-1620 cm-1
    mask_g = (shift >= 1550) & (shift <= 1620)
    ig = np.max(intensity[mask_g]) if np.any(mask_g) else 0
    
    # I_D: max intensity in 1300-1400 cm-1
    mask_d = (shift >= 1300) & (shift <= 1400)
    id_val = np.max(intensity[mask_d]) if np.any(mask_d) else 0
    
    ratio = ig / id_val if id_val != 0 else 0
    data.append({'파일명': f.replace('.csv', ''), 'IG_ID': ratio})

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
